review.contract: N5.8 preserves the existing administrative-report data authority and downloadable-file contract while exposing only the closed csv/xlsx/pdf format set.
review.formats: CSV remains UTF-8 and escaped, XLSX remains ClosedXML-backed, and PDF remains real backend-generated QuestPDF output; MIME and extension are deterministic and unknown formats fail closed.
review.security: Existing Exportar/admin authorization and audit boundaries are preserved; regression evidence covers RBAC denial, invalid format rejection, PDF validity, and existing CSV/XLSX behavior.
review.persistence: No new export persistence, job, blob, table, migration, or second source of truth is required by N5.8.
review.rollback: Rollback is bounded to revert/forward-fix of the export contract/generator/API/UI changes while preserving pre-existing CSV/XLSX behavior; no destructive DDL rollback is required.
review.gates: N5.8.G certification records exact-functional-head integral acceptance, backend tests, frontend production build, MySQL migration regression, validate, and VAEP engine as PASS.
review.busywork: No additional Jules dispatch, manifest, schema, dataset, metric, or evidence-only filler is required for H.
